rationale: advertise.co.uk's /news/index.html (page b1cd8ffb, page_type news-index, deployed, live at https://advertise.co.uk/news/index.html — 200, 65 KB, zero items, /data/news-archive.json 404 as of 2026-09-03 12:3xZ) is bugs_open/444's standing repro for a listing page shipped with no item producer. Three peers routed the enablement to this lane on 2026-09-02: portfolio_positioning relayed the owner's ask ('record the webpronews.com rss feed details ... we could add it to the news sources'), the 444 session diagnosed that the page needs BOTH content_features.news_feed in the classification spec AND a content_sources row, and the 444 plan's enablement contract names exactly that recipe ('feeds: author content_features.news_feed in the classification spec (idea.uk 2026-08-25 is the worked example) and/or seed content_sources'). MEASURED 2026-09-03: the site's current classification row ec005136 (domain-research-classifier, 2026-09-02) carries no content_features key at all; 0 content_sources rows for the site; 0 rows naming webpronews fleet-wide; 22 pages build_status=deployed. WHY BY HAND: the framework's own author of the key is evaluate_news_feed; its matcher (matchVerticalNews) reads industry/site_type/category and domain substrings, this site's signals are ''/editorial/editorial/advertise.co.uk, and verticalNewsMap has no advertising/marketing/media key — so it returns nil and writes nothing on no-match (its only carrier is improvement-loop anyway). Same wall and same remedy as idea.uk's 2026-08-25 hand-authored entry. WHY THE SOURCES ARE INSERTED HERE, NOT LEFT TO THE SEEDER: seed_content_sources_action.go SKIPS source_type rss ('requires manual URL config'), so the owner's feed can only arrive by hand; and it returns early when the site has ANY active source, so once the rss row exists it would never create the news_search rows the spec names — a spec naming source_types the site will never get would be a lie. The file therefore creates exactly what the seeder would have (same names, same config shape, region='uk' as regionForDomain() now sets for .uk domains — commit 0a408f8db, live in v1.0.1358, binary-verified this session) plus the rss row the seeder cannot. EDITORIAL CAUTION honoured: the owner endorsed the FEED's content, not the old Drupal advertise.co.uk's wholesale-import pattern (classifier: 'Articles imported wholesale from WebProNews — no original content'). Every item goes through feed-triage's score_relevance against THIS spec (feed_triage_actions.go: >=50 relevant, 20–49 review, <20 rejected, flagged→rejected), and the feed sampled 2026-09-03 is broad US tech/business (Anthropic classifiers, FCC robocalls, Gemini 3.8, C# union types) — which is also why five UK-region news_search queries anchored on the institutions the site's own vertical_landscape names (ASA, CAP, IAB UK, AA/WARC) are added alongside it: the landscape says 'ASA rulings, platform policy changes, and IAB UK data releases provide a real news stream', and content_direction requires named UK sources. No api_news: no LLM-authored items on a site whose proposition is plain honest explanation (mission_brief). Mechanics: supersede+insert on site_specs exactly as evaluate_news_feed does (never UPDATE in place), old row pinned by id in the guard so a re-run of the classifier refuses rather than merging onto the wrong row; plain INSERT with no ON CONFLICT so a concurrent write fails loudly; post-check reproduces the live content-feed-trigger.find_news_sites predicate reduced to this site and asserts it selects; fleet before/after counts in a temp table prove +6 sources / +1 spec and nothing else; ROLLBACK refuses if any ingested item is attached to a page or work item; VERIFY is read-only and reports triage outcomes as NOTICEs. DRY RUN, stated precisely because the first attempt did NOT test anything: run-migrations.sh's doomed-transaction probe REFUSED the file ('contains its own ROLLBACK/ABORT') on a header comment that merely named its reversal sidecar — a probe declined is printed as 'not probed' and reads as a property of the SQL. Re-run by hand instead, COMMIT swapped for ROLLBACK against the live DB, which executes every guard: it failed immediately on min(uuid) (no such function in Postgres) inside the precondition block, that was fixed to (array_agg(id))[1], and the re-run then passed with the POST-CHECK NOTICE firing and a follow-up census proving nothing persisted (0 sources, no content_features, 1 classification row). So every guard in this file has been executed against live data. Both traps are now LANDMINES entries.

plan.summary: advertise.co.uk has a deployed news-index page and no item producer: its classification spec has no content_features.news_feed key (the framework's automatic author cannot match an advertising site) and it has zero content_sources rows (the seeder cannot create rss rows and would not run once one exists). Migration 746 authors the key by supersede+insert on the pinned classifier row, and inserts six sources: the owner-endorsed WebProNews rss feed and five UK-region news_search queries anchored on ASA/CAP/IAB UK/AA-WARC — the exact rows the seeder would have written for a .uk domain plus the one it cannot. The live trigger predicate then selects the site on its next 6-hourly tick; feed-triage scores every item against the spec so off-topic WebProNews items are rejected, not republished; render_news_section's existing rerender path fills the news-listing component from content_feed_items with no LLM. Data only, one site, reversible.

edits.rationale: Both halves of the 444 diagnosis in one transaction, because the seeder's early-return makes them order-dependent if done separately: the spec flag is what the trigger and the seeder select on; the rss row cannot come from the seeder; the news_search rows would never come from it once the rss row exists.
edits.sketch: BEGIN; TEMP TABLE _746_before (fleet counts). DO pre: exactly 1 current classification row AND its id = ec005136 (pinned) AND no content_features; 0 content_sources for the site (any is_active); 0 rows naming webpronews fleet-wide; >=1 deployed page; page b1cd8ffb page_type='news-index'. WITH old AS (UPDATE site_specs SET is_current=false, superseded_at=now() WHERE id=ec005136 ... RETURNING) INSERT new row: old.data || {content_features:{news_feed:{recommended:true, separate_page:true, source_types:[rss,news_search], vertical_keywords:[5], reason}}}, source='authored', created_by='news-feed-ingestion-lane'. INSERT 6 content_sources (no ON CONFLICT): rss WebProNews {feed_url, max_items:15}; 5× news_search {query, num_results:10, region:'uk'} named 'News Search: <kw>' as seedNewsSearchSources does. DO post: recommended=true, 2 types, 5 keywords, (data - 'content_features') = old.data verbatim, old row superseded; 6/1/5/5 sources, all next_fetch_at NULL; the live find_news_sites predicate reduced to this site returns 1; fleet counts moved by exactly +6/+1. COMMIT.

plan.risks: (1) Cost: six sources fetched daily (five Firecrawl news searches + one 1 MB RSS pull) plus one feed-triage LLM scoring run per orchestrator cycle for this site — the same per-site cost idea.uk and webdesign.co.uk already carry; bounded by fetch_interval 24h and max_items. (2) WebProNews is high-volume and mostly off-topic for a UK advertising site; the control is triage's threshold, so the first cycle's relevant/review/rejected split is the number to read (VERIFY reports it) — if 'review' piles up, the site-level relevance_threshold is the lever, not the source. (3) The news JSON commit step resolves the repo from step config → sites.github_repo → default; advertise.co.uk's github_repo is EMPTY (idea.uk's says vm-sites) — its 22 deployed pages prove the default path works for this site, but the first commit_news step is the place a reviewer should watch; the page fill itself goes through page_rerender, not that commit. (4) The five query strings are a first cut; idea.uk's lesson is to retune after the first ingestion, and the (site_id, name) dedup key means a retune is DELETE old row + INSERT new, not an UPDATE of the spec alone. (5) The guard pins the classifier row by id, so if the classifier re-runs before apply the migration refuses — correct, and the author re-reads rather than force-merging. (6) Number 746 could be claimed by another lane between authoring and commit — re-checked at commit; the ledger keys on filename so a collision is a naming ambiguity, not a data one.
